summary: A personal atlas of where you've been, on a flat map or a 3D globe.
what: A personal atlas. Mark each country visited, wished for or ruled out, keep a journal per country with ratings and visit dates, and watch the tally climb against the world's 195 countries, on a flat map or a 3D globe.
who: Anyone keeping track of where they have been and where they want to go next.

facts.label: Data
facts.value: Your browser only, exportable as JSON

flow.label: Your countries, journal and progress
flow.note: a Zustand store, persisted to localStorage

flow.label: Two renderers over the same data
flow.note: a D3 SVG Mercator map and a WebGL globe (react-globe.gl, Three.js)

flow.label: Live layers
flow.note: US and Canadian travel advisories, and a live aircraft from adsb.lol, through the app's own API routes

decisions: Two renderers over one dataset: a D3 SVG Mercator map and a WebGL globe through react-globe.gl and Three.js, switching views without converting data.
No account and no server: country status, journal and progress live in Zustand, persisted to localStorage.
Data stays portable: the whole state exports and imports as JSON.
